“Just sitting with discomfort, without trying to escape or numb it in anyway, without exception, without a goal in mind, without seeking anything, including some abstract notion of “comfort” —that’s the juicy place, the place of creative transformation, the place where newness shines” — Jeff Foster, The Way of Rest

[](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!1yC3!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F48f62310-642b-4e86-b549-6577e9884d16_1290x1755.jpeg)

![](/assets/the-juicy-place/3f66035aab78.jpeg)

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Advice that is so simple and yet so hard to follow. It seems to get at the core of everything.

It’s a direct affront to restlessness, to everything we are on a daily basis.

**To confront discomfort by embodying it.**

A few of years ago Jeff was hit with a rare and debilitating disease. It knocked him for a six and he had to eat his own words.

You can read about it here:

1.  ["I WASN’T PREPARED FOR THIS”](http://r.lifewithoutacentre.com/acg5x5bbedt7e.html?t=1617644519)

2.  [“I WRITE BOOKS ABOUT ACCEPTANCE... BUT I JUST CANNOT ACCEPT](http://r.lifewithoutacentre.com/mk/mr/nKauvvrCJ8OLrBhtl3_WWyJhPiPX3Omt8ZvYdn2aMIsAbIIeMNT6HxbCcWBe46RBt9Zc3B5snE0RnjhXoAMtjt83H5vcXnYPM_qAtAX1eCIJOeeC) *[THIS](http://r.lifewithoutacentre.com/mk/mr/nKauvvrCJ8OLrBhtl3_WWyJhPiPX3Omt8ZvYdn2aMIsAbIIeMNT6HxbCcWBe46RBt9Zc3B5snE0RnjhXoAMtjt83H5vcXnYPM_qAtAX1eCIJOeeC)*[”](http://r.lifewithoutacentre.com/mk/mr/nKauvvrCJ8OLrBhtl3_WWyJhPiPX3Omt8ZvYdn2aMIsAbIIeMNT6HxbCcWBe46RBt9Zc3B5snE0RnjhXoAMtjt83H5vcXnYPM_qAtAX1eCIJOeeC)

The message is simple and it’s a joy to read.

*Walking this path?*

That’s another thing.

Blessings…

And that’s,
